messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] covariate
parts:
I'm not sure I understand, but if you want to calculate the covariance between phenotypes, you could first pull out the phenotype data from a cross object:

phe <- mycross$pheno

and then use var() or cor().

var(phe)
cor(phe)
cor(phe[,1], phe[,2])

karl
